source: BBOC 2025 American Conference Preview Part 1+2 (Mike Calabrese/Stuckey/Duck)

teams.key_avoids: Tougher slate than 2024: at Kansas State, at Tulane, at Air Force, at UTSA; neutral vs Navy to close. ~8 losable games.
teams.bboc_notes: Both hosts UNDER (Stuckey's favorite total). Loses Bryson Daily (engine of option O), Joe-Moore OL, entire 3-deep concerns at tackle (tackles critical to option comms). 2024's 10 wins were schedule-fueled (beat teams that fired coaches/quit). Front-seven undersized as always. Collin 6.8. 2nd-tier AAC team, negative regression expected.

teams.qb_status: Battle — Grayson Loftus (Duke) vs Connor Harrell (UNC)
teams.key_avoids: Non-con brutal: at Georgia, App State, at UNC, Monmouth. Home vs Temple + Rice (the two new-staff teams) key.
teams.bboc_notes: Great long-term hire (Albin won 30 in 3 yrs at Ohio) but year-one full rebuild. QB unsettled (Albin won't tip hand). 10 new faces on D, lots of FCS/JUCO. Both hosts pass — too much unknown, OL/trenches the risk. Collin 3.2, tiny over value, not enough. Win total = 2.5 juiced over / 3.5 juiced under.

teams.key_avoids: Tougher than 2024: at NC State, BYU home, at Coastal; conf Army/Tulane/Memphis/UTSA. Swapped 2 G5 non-cons for NC State + BYU.
teams.bboc_notes: 2024 second-half surge was a MIRAGE (beat Temple/FAU/Tulsa/NT — bad teams). Whole big-physical secondary GONE — could be way down. Houser cut INTs vs Garcia but still top-20 turnover-worthy rate. Air-raid tempo (Blake Harrell HC, ex-interim). OL lost 7000 snaps (C/RG/LT). Collin 5.8, under value. Both lean under.

teams.key_avoids: At Maryland opener; must sweep FIU/Rice/UAB/Tulsa to go over. Tougher AAC: Memphis, USF, Navy, Tulane, UConn, ECU.
teams.bboc_notes: HIGH VARIANCE shootout team — new HC Kittley (WKU air-raid, youngest+tallest HC in FBS) reunites w/ QB Veltkamp + WR Messer (the WKU Zappe blueprint). Offense could be electric BUT defense potentially historically bad (0 returning starters, 120th ret prod, could give up 400+). 'Score 38 and lose.' Season-long no play; week-to-week OVER team. Collin ~4.5 on market. Duck bet under early.

teams.key_avoids: SCHEDULE LOTTERY — FCS, at Georgia St, at Troy, host Arkansas (letdown spot for Ark), FAU, Tulsa, UAB. Could be 6-1/7-0 without being 95% of last yr.
teams.bboc_notes: Massive turnover — lost QB Henigan + top-2 RBs + top-3 WRs (2 NFL) + TE + 4 OL to NFL; may start 10 transfers on D. HIGH VARIANCE (Florida-State-type range). But money (FedEx) + good recruiting/portal. Collin ~8.5, tiny over value via the soft schedule; Stuckey flags fading LATE if market overreacts. Top-mix AAC but most downside of the contenders.

teams.key_avoids: Starts 7-0 easy (VMI, UAB, at Tulsa, Rice, Air Force, at Temple, FAU) then BRUTAL close: North Texas, at Notre Dame, USF, at Memphis, Army.
teams.bboc_notes: Service-academy regression flag (double-digit win seasons historically fall ≥3 wins). All 3 hosts UNDER. Horvath + all backs back, but lost ENTIRE 3-deep at tackle (tackles critical to option comms). Also lost historically-good red-zone/turnover/health luck. Best pass D Navy's ever had now gutted (corners/safeties gone). Collin 8.15. Back-half schedule is the killer.

teams.qb_status: Battle — Reese Poffenbarger (FCS Albany) / Drew Mestemaker
teams.key_avoids: AVOIDS Memphis + Tulane. Among top-8 teams only faces Army (road) — and gets Army early. Navy at home in great spot. 7 home games. Hosts USF/Navy/UTSA.
teams.bboc_notes: DARK HORSE — all 3 hosts take a longshot flyer (20-1) to win AAC. Eric Morris offense trusted (2024 was 5-1 before Chandler Morris shoulder injury derailed it). New QB (Mestemaker looked great in bowl; Poffenbarger FCS star). Whole season hinges on new DC Cassidy fixing the D (Sam Houston pedigree + his transfers). Schedule very conducive. Collin values over 6.5.

teams.qb_status: Battle — Chase Jenkins (converted WR, QB1 in spring)
teams.key_avoids: Draws the AAC top-5 — could wear down late. Small roster.
teams.bboc_notes: New HC Scott Abell brings a unique gun/inverted-triple-option (Davidson — led level in rushing 10 of 15 yrs). Very SMALL team (RB 5-7/160), could wear down late; OL lost 3 to P4/NFL. 2024 Rice was close (beat UTSA, near Tulane/Navy/USF). Collin 3.9, lean over 3.5 but pass season-long — great weekly DOG to back ATS. Scheme hard to prep for.

teams.key_avoids: Brutal start: Boise (wk1), at Florida, at Miami — could start 0-3 (doesn't hurt conf). Tough conf road: North Texas, Memphis, Navy. Bye before hosting UTSA.
teams.key_injury: Byrum Brown — hamstring (spring); health is the whole season
teams.bboc_notes: Top-tier AAC contender (Stuckey's future at 8-1). Ceiling tied ENTIRELY to Byrum Brown's health — 2023 he had 4100 yds/37 TD; backup is a freshman. 14th in ret prod. RB room downgraded (lost Joiner/Kearse). Todd Orlando D questionable but Golesh yr3 recruiting well. Collin 6.8, over value but takes the conf longshot instead due to health risk + brutal early slate.

teams.qb_status: Battle — Gio McCoy (likely) vs Evan Simon
teams.key_avoids: Easy games all on the ROAD (bad); home slate tough. Win total hinges on road games vs UMass/Charlotte/Tulsa (the new-coach teams). Opens at UMass, host Howard.
teams.bboc_notes: Great hire (Keeler — 2 FCS titles, transitioned Sam Houston to 10-win FBS). Power-spread run scheme (Walker, 68% run at Montana St), ball-control to protect a bad D. Improvement via culture but WR + CB rooms 'look really rough' (D2 corners). Collin small over, both pass. Unders early to protect D. New DC Brian Smith (Rice) to fix pass D over time.

teams.qb_status: Transfer — Jake Retzlaff (from BYU, must win job)
teams.key_avoids: 'Scheduling surprise tax bill.' Non-con Duke + Ole Miss early; conf at UTSA + at Memphis back-to-back (where total lost). Temple/Charlotte/FAU (new teams) to close — banked as wins but maybe not.
teams.bboc_notes: Both hosts UNDER (Collin 7.7). Lost QB Mensa (Duke), OC Hughes (Oregon), 8 D starters — the front-7 that CARRIED them. Portal'd 34 3-stars. Retzlaff (BYU, circus exit) doesn't move needle, just raises floor. Every position group worse on paper. Duck faded them wk1 (Northwestern +7.5). High floor (plays bottom-4) but 8-4 likely = under.

teams.qb_status: Returning — Kirk Francis (immobile, may get benched)
teams.key_avoids: Must win openers (Abilene Christian FCS-playoff team, at New Mexico St). Then 5 of AAC top-6 + at Oklahoma St + Oregon St home. Duck/Mike see 2-10.
teams.bboc_notes: HOST SPLIT — Mike + Duck HARD UNDER (2-10, team quit after ECU loss last yr, 132nd defense, 500 yds/game allowed); Stuckey DISAGREES, likes Lamb (energy/culture upgrade over 'worst coach in CFB' Wilson), sees 4-5 wins, tiny over value. Air-raid (Tiny-light quick game). OL the concern. Historically-bad pass D can only improve. Stuckey won't hit window.

teams.key_avoids: Road-heavy for the winnable games: at UConn, at Rice, at Tulsa, at FAU (not home for any bottom-7 team). BYE before Army (2nd option team + new AF-pedigree DC = sneaky live spot). Plays 3 option teams.
teams.bboc_notes: FADE (3rd straight under bet) — Mike hammers HC Trent Dilfer's toxic/dismissive culture ('not like we're Alabama'), 120th ret prod, lost best weapon Amari Thomas. QB Kitna (17 TD/11 INT, 6% turnover-worthy). Bright spot: new DC Steve Russ (Air Force, 8 yrs) + reloaded secondary (Pitt/Md/Kent/BC transfers) — relevant vs 3 option teams. Collin 4.3, no play.

teams.key_avoids: AVOIDS Memphis, Tulsa, Navy, UAB. Loses to A&M but favored in ~9-10 else. Gets Tulane off a bye. Easy road slate after A&M. Trailer 29-3 at home, 16-5 in Nov.
teams.bboc_notes: PICK TO WIN AAC (both Mike + Duck; Stuckey over lean). ENTIRE offense returns (11 starters, elite QB Owen McCown, deep OL, 4 huge pass-catching TEs) — best O in conf. D in full refresh (lost top-5 DL, all LB snaps, no returning DB starters) BUT DC Loepp makes edge monsters. KEY: cut the 113 penalties (2nd-most in CFB, cost 2-3 games) — Traylor's whole offseason focus. Collin 8.38, over value.
